name: B12
summary: AI builder for websites, online stores and web apps, edited by chat or in a visual editor, with a free plan on a subdomain and optional client tools such as intake forms, email marketing and contracts.
best_for: freelancers, consultants and small businesses that want an AI-generated site they can edit by chat, with optional intake forms, email marketing and contracts on the higher plan
skip_if: you need a fully free custom domain beyond year one, a fixed price for expert-built sites shown on the page, or unlimited launched projects
honest_knock: Free is limited to 5 AI credits a day and 30 a month. The custom domain is free only for the first year, and the renewal price is not on the pricing page. The yearly versus monthly price is not clear from the page, and the expert-built packages are priced separately and not shown here.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Website · Website plan shown as $24 / month with 100 AI credits a month and up to 10 launched projects
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on b12.io/pricing) B12 sells an AI website, store and web-app builder in three do-it-yourself plans, plus a separate "experts do it for you" tab that we did not price. Free costs $0 a month, publishes on a b12sites.com subdomain and gives 5 daily AI credits with a maximum of 30 a month. Website is shown at $24 a month and adds a custom domain, 100 AI credits a month, up to 10 launched projects, commerce, backends, integrations and email and chat support. Website + Client Engagement is shown at $78 a month and adds 300 AI credits a month, up to 30 launched projects, a custom email address, client intake, email marketing, a contact manager, contracts with eSignature and file uploads. The page carries a limited-time offer of $1 for the first 7 days on the paid plans for new users. The custom domain is free for the first year only; the renewal price is not stated. The page has a monthly and a yearly billing toggle and we could not tell which one the shown prices belong to, so check the toggle at checkout. Prices are in dollars as shown; the page does not name a currency code.

schema_offer.description: Website, Website plan shown as $24 / month with 100 AI credits a month and up to 10 launched projects; Website + Client Engagement $78 / month; Free plan $0; the page shows both a monthly and a yearly billing toggle and we could not tell which price each toggle state shows; $1 for the first 7 days is a limited-time offer for new users; dollar sign as shown, currency code not stated on the page. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-07.

exit_test.what: A fictional operations-consulting prompt at 14:11:58 UTC produced a complete Home, Services, About and Contact concept at 14:17:13 UTC: 5 minutes 15 seconds including account creation, not isolated generation time. The Home/Services headings matched the requested business; no invented customer names or metrics were seen in the inspected headings. One AI edit added Quick audit $450, 30-day fix plan $1,200 and Monthly check-in $300/month in about 2 minutes. The source attributes 1 consumed credit to the two actions; counter values are recorded literally, not reinterpreted as remaining balance. A custom domain was behind Upgrade. Nothing published. Em-dash seen in generated copy. The categorised content-media kit was not imported; pain tasks were the core action.
exit_test.awkward: Custom domain requires upgrade; a daily counter cap was absent from Plans; renewal disabling described by email.

sessions.what: We built a four-page website for a fictional consultancy on B12's Free plan on 12 November 2026, from one prompt, and asked its AI chat for one edit. We stopped at checkout before paying and did not publish. We did not test export, support or invitations.
findings: Prompt sent at 14:11:58 UTC, first full draft (Home, Services, About, Contact) visible at 14:17:13 UTC. That is 5 minutes 15 seconds and includes the time Daan spent creating the account, so the build time on its own was shorter.
The Home and Services headings matched the prompt, and we saw no invented customer names or figures in them. One generated sentence contains an em dash.
A chat request to add three fictional packages with prices took about 2 minutes and added a Packages section with Quick audit ($450), 30-day fix plan ($1,200) and Monthly check-in ($300 per month).
After both actions the credit counter read 'Monthly credits 1/30' and 'Daily credits 1/5'. The Plans page lists 30 credits a month for Free but shows no daily limit.
Domains showed an 'Upgrade' label. On Free the site would sit at a b12sites.com address, so a custom domain needs a paid plan.

At checkout for the Website plan, monthly billing was preselected: '$24 / month, $1 for first 7 days'. Yearly showed $20 / month with 'Save 16%'; the Plans page said 'Save 15%'. We saw no tax line, setup fee or seat count.
The checkout said auto-renewal 'can be disabled at any time by contacting hello@b12.io'. We saw no cancel button and did not test it.
